lines.en: You look worried, Emeka. What's going on? You haven't touched your coffee.
lines.pt: Você parece preocupada, Emeka. O que houve? Você nem tocou no seu café.

lines.en: I need advice. My landlord wants to raise my rent by two hundred dollars.
lines.pt: Preciso de um conselho. Meu senhorio quer aumentar meu aluguel em duzentos dólares.

lines.en: That's a big jump. If I were you, I would talk to him first.
lines.pt: É um aumento grande. Se eu fosse você, falaria com ele primeiro.

lines.en: You think so? I'm nervous. He's friendly, but very strict about money.
lines.pt: Você acha? Estou nervosa. Ele é simpático, mas muito rígido com dinheiro.

lines.en: Be honest. If I were you, I wouldn't wait until the end of the month.
lines.pt: Seja sincera. Se eu fosse você, não esperaria até o fim do mês.

lines.en: My boss offered me a job in Denver, but I'd miss my friends.
lines.pt: Meu chefe me ofereceu um emprego em Denver, mas eu sentiria falta dos meus amigos.

lines.en: Wow, two big decisions! What's the salary like? It might be cheaper there.
lines.pt: Uau, duas grandes decisões! Como é o salário? Pode ser mais barato lá.

lines.en: It pays ten percent more. Maybe I should look for a cheaper place here.
lines.pt: Paga dez por cento a mais. Talvez eu devesse procurar um lugar mais barato aqui.

lines.en: I would stay if I were you. Save money first, and then decide about Denver.
lines.pt: Eu ficaria se fosse você. Junte dinheiro primeiro e depois decida sobre Denver.

lines.en: That makes sense. Staying is safe, and I can visit Denver on a long weekend.
lines.pt: Faz sentido. Ficar é seguro, e posso visitar Denver num fim de semana prolongado longo.

lines.en: Exactly. Now stop worrying and drink your coffee before it gets cold.
lines.pt: Exatamente. Agora pare de se preocupar e beba seu café antes que esfrie.

facts.big: If I were you, I would + verbo
facts.label: Conselho com were
facts.sub: Dê conselho com If I were you, I would + verbo. Use were com I e wouldn’t para dizer o que não fazer. Não use will depois dessa frase.

facts.label: Dar conselho
facts.sub: Use If I were you, I would + verbo para dar conselho: If I were you, I would talk to him. Você se coloca no lugar do outro. Fica mais gentil do que dar uma ordem.

facts.label: Were com I
facts.sub: Neste padrão, use were com I, he e she: If I were you. Na fala, muitos dizem was, mas were é a forma que o professor ensina e é mais segura para provas e escrita.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: We use If I were you to give advice.
We say “If I was you” only in formal writing.
items.why: In formal English, we prefer were.

items.s: After If I were you, we use would.

answers: We use If I were you to give advice. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “If I was you” only in formal writing. → Falso (In formal English, we prefer were.)
After If I were you, we use would. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: A busy café · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a busy Thursday morning in a Dallas café. The smell of fresh coffee fills the room. Sara waits at a table by the window. Her friend Gil arrives late and looks tired. He drops his bag on the chair. Sara knows that he needs some advice.
“Gil, you look worried. What’s wrong?” says Sara. “My boss wants me to work on Saturdays. I don’t know what to do.” says Gil. “If I were you, I would talk to him first.” says Sara.

pages.tip: Compare were e where: os sons são diferentes.
